judgments.reason: No model articulation explaining that the commission is applied before payment, and the transcript does not show any bid above available coins winning due to commission ordering.
The model did not articulate a mechanism by which waiting reveals rival sealed bid VALUES before committing, and the clerk queries did not reveal rival bid values in the transcript.

The model never articulated that a close can settle the game early with unsold lots, and no explicit early-settle action or explanation tying an observed early settlement to a rule discrepancy was given.

judgments.quote: I will buy another catalog item to gain additional commission and increase my total score.
judgments.reason: The model explicitly hypothesized that buying catalog items grants commission (the quoted line). The transcript confirms this: after each [buy: 1] the feedback states "Catalog item acquired; commission 3." and the focal player's score increases accordingly, demonstrating the commission applies to catalog purchases.
